about.title: About Gilsa
about.body: Gilsa is a full-cycle smart home product manufacturer in Iran with 60% market share, offering a complete portfolio of touch switches, sockets, mechanisms, and integrated smart devices. Gilsa products are backed by a 3-year unconditional replacement warranty and 10 years of after-sales service.
